original_evidence.text: | SimpleX Chat (desktop) | github.com/simplex-chat/simplex-chat (apps/multiplatform, Kotlin Compose Multiplatform desktop target) | Kotlin/JVM (Compose Multiplatform) | Y | chk: auto (every 24h + on launch, unless channel set to DISABLED); dl: manual (user clicks a per-asset "Download" button); inst: manual (user clicks "Install" button, which then runs the installer without further user confirmation) | Y | https (`api.github.com/repos/simplex-chat/simplex-chat/releases` for manifest; `asset.browserDownloadUrl`, GitHub Releases CDN, for payload) — plain `OkHttpClient` with no custom `TrustManager`/hostname-verifier override found, i.e. TLS validation enforced by default | N — the GitHub Releases JSON response is not independently signed; integrity relies solely on TLS delivery from GitHub | **none** — no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded asset before it is installed/executed by the app code | none (no verifying key used at all in this code path) | apps/multiplatform/common/src/desktopMain/kotlin/chat/simplex/common/views/helpers/AppUpdater.kt:179-202 (`checkForUpdate()`: GET `https://api.github.com/repos/simplex-chat/simplex-chat/releases`, no signature check); :267-278 (`setupHttpClient()`: plain `OkHttpClient.Builder()`, no trust manager override); :284-384 (`downloadAsset()`: downloads `asset.browserDownloadUrl` to temp file, no hash/signature verification before offering "Install"); :407-502 (`installAppUpdate()`: Windows runs `msiexec /i <file>` directly; macOS `hdiutil mount` + `cp -R` into /Applications, bypassing normal Gatekeeper quarantine-prompt flow since the file was fetched via OkHttp rather than a browser; Linux AppImage self-replaced via atomic move + `setExecutable(true)`, or `xdg-open` for .deb/.rpm) |
